verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents a path-versioned API (/v1) and keeps a per-release breaking-changes register for API surface changes, with upgrade guidance, plus dated product and SDK changelogs. However, it publishes no deprecation window or support-horizon commitment, so the 'documented deprecation policy' half of the story is only approximated by after-the-fact change notes. missing for 10: a formal deprecation policy with notice periods, a support-horizon guarantee for API versions, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Activepieces maintains a per-release breaking-changes register covering API surface changes
